about_the_game:
Infinity Mask is a stylized third-person action-adventure that blends fast-paced combat, platforming, puzzle-solving, and rich storytelling in a world shaped by Norse mythology. Set after the fall of Ragnarök, the game invites players into a broken yet mysterious world—full of secrets, ancient ruins, and mechanical remnants of lost civilizations.

You play as Embla, an Andromen—a hybrid being born from machine and human soul. Awakened without memories, you must explore vast biomes, uncover hidden temples, and reconstruct a forgotten past to understand the power of the Infinity Mask.

  • ⚔ Melee & Ranged Combat: Mix precise sword attacks with elemental crossbow bolts. Use your shield, chain combos, and unleash special abilities.

  • 🔧 Unique Gadgets & Movement: Equip powerful tools like the Grappling Hook, Gravity Glove, Wingsuit, and more to traverse the world and solve complex puzzles.

  • 🧩 Ancient Dungeons & Challenges: Unlock the secrets of long-forgotten temples with clever puzzles, pressure-based mechanisms, and interactive environments.

  • 🌍 Handcrafted Biomes: Travel through lush jungles, icy mountains, scorched deserts, and ruined cities—each with its own story and visual identity.

  • 🧠 Character & World Progression: Upgrade your skill tree, uncover hidden data logs, and piece together the mystery of Embla’s origin.

  • 🎵 Atmospheric Sound & Story: Dive into a rich narrative with stylized visuals and an emotional soundtrack inspired by Norse sagas and futuristic ruins.
